svg.font-family: Helvetica, Arial, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
svg.title: How the earlier folders and the domains of thought meet the live account
svg.desc: What 16 earlier theory folders and 12 domains of thought, from Chinese and Buddhist thought to systems thinking, ecology, economics and AI alignment, claim in their own terms: 1,183 claims, each read against the live account. It states 491 in whole or in part and takes up 189 to say otherwise. 376 it does not state: a reader proposes the connection here. 105 it does not take up, and 22 stand only in its history. Every dot is an AI reading, and no person’s. Of 337 agreements, 130 are with a checked law, 67 with a thesis or method, and 140 rest on a reader’s join. A shared word is not a correspondence, and agreement is drawn no more prominently than divergence. 327 entries rest on the AI’s knowledge of a text not stored here, unchecked against that text. A random check of 100 entries estimates that about 14.2% of all carry a wrong label or target role and 3.2% a wrong reading. Drawn as a matrix: a row per folder or domain, a column per part of the account, in each cell up to two dots per relation, filled for what the account takes up and, below it, a ring for what is proposed here. The relations count the claims drawn; 3 that stand only in history or are not carried also carry one, which the crosswalk’s table counts.
svg.text: How the earlier folders and the domains of thought meet the live account
Drawn by connection_map.py from the crosswalk’s 1,183 claims, each read against the live account. A row is an earlier
folder or a domain of thought, a column the part of the account its claims are read against; read a row across.
Every dot is an AI reading, no person’s. Agreement is drawn no more prominently
A random check of 100 entries estimates that about 14.2% of all 1,183 carry a wrong label or target role and 3.2% a wrong reading.
3 carried · 488 in part · 189 changed · 376 proposed here · 22 only in history · 105 not carried
Drives, narrative attractors and the construction of mind
間 and 文言 as formal language
The relational self and 大同
The selfishness spiral and narrative-value frames
Spirit, Token, Space and the Yi substrate
Cooperative abundance and freely built worlds (The Fork)
智善: intelligence must be good
Chinese classical thought: what the maps have not reached
Buddhist thought, as far as the account has reached it

svg.text: filled: the account takes it up (states it, or says otherwise)
ring: proposed here, not stated by the account
In a cell, up to two dots per relation in the order above, its area growing with the claims; the dots the account takes up above, the proposed below.
The legend’s counts are drawn claims, by relation. The 127 claims only in history or not carried draw no dot
(3 of them carry a relation, which the crosswalk’s table counts).
Beside a folder or domain the number counts all its claims; beside a part of the account, the drawn claims read against it,
a claim read against several parts counting at each.
Every claim with its targets and how far each has been seen: the crosswalk (CROSSWALK.md, in the same folder). The same data to explore:
the connection map: on the reader’s site, once it is published, its Connections page; or map.html in this folder,
opened from a clone (GitHub shows it only as source).
